Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching import/export businesses in Bangladesh, and Mazada Group came up as a established player in the trading space. The kind of work you do — coordinating shipments across multiple parties, managing customs documentation, LC paperwork, and keeping buyers updated on shipment status — is exactly the kind of operation that loses money through manual delays.

Here's what I see: every shipment involves 5-10 parties (buyer, seller, shipping line, customs broker, freight forwarder, bank), and right now every status update is a phone call or email. When a container is delayed at Chittagong port, your team manually notifies the buyer, the warehouse, and the finance team. That's 3 calls per delay, and delays happen on 30-40% of shipments.

I built an AI operations agent that automates shipment status updates — it pulls tracking data, sends automatic notifications to all parties when status changes, handles document requests (invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin), and answers buyer enquiries about delivery timelines 24/7. Your team stops making status-update calls and focuses on closing new deals.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
